author: Wzyss
install_msg: Thank you for installing ListingInterest! Set a category and notify targets with [p]listinginterestset, then use [p]listinginterest reply or bind to attach interest buttons to listings.
name: ListingInterest
short: Interest buttons on product listings that open private channels and notify sellers.
description: Attach an interest button to listings via bot reply or by binding a bot-owned message. When clicked, creates a private channel for the buyer and configured staff/sellers, optionally pings users/roles in-channel, and DMs users (roles expanded to members). Managers can close interest channels.
